name: Servo override is switched on only after the page has read its values
step: Servo override is switched on only after the page has read its values
rationale:
Ported from rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite PR #2552 (Issue #2496):
on the servo pages, the OK action of the override dialog switched
the override on without the runtime-loaded check that the live write already applies.
After a failed read, pressing Tool and OK still sent the override to the flight
controller, and nothing the pilot changed left the radio until the override was
switched off and on again.

The enable branch now returns early until runtime.loaded is true. The disable branch
is unchanged. Documents the behaviour on the Servos page.

The harness drives the Servos page (app/pages/servos.lua, which replaced the PWM and
BUS pages with MSP API 22.16) through the real page runtime: list, tile press, editor,
Tool, OK. 11 checks. Against the unpatched page the read-failed check fails.
